candidates.name: Bell's Palsy
support_spans: disappearance of nasolabial fold in right face
Incomplete right eyelid closure with visible sclera during maximal effort
Weak muscle strength of right frontalis and orbicularis oculi
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of facial muscle weakness, incomplete eyelid closure, and disappearance of the nasolabial fold are consistent with Bell's Palsy.

candidates.name: Pontine Stroke
support_spans: Lesion located in dorsolateral right pons
Hypo-intense signal in T1-weighted images
Moderate-intense signal in T2-weighted images
candidates.why: The presence of a lesion in the right pons on brain MRI, along with the patient's symptoms of dizziness, diplopia, and facial weakness, suggests a pontine stroke.

candidates.name: Facial Nerve Neuroma
support_spans: Significantly decreased amplitude of right facial nerve compound muscular action potential compared to healthy side
Presence of insertional activity in right facial muscles with greatly reduced voluntary activity
candidates.why: The electrophysiological tests showing decreased amplitude of the facial nerve compound muscular action potential and insertional activity in facial muscles suggest a facial nerve neuroma.
